prompt: A burly armored warrior in dented iron plate, side profile facing south-west, mid-collapse onto one buckling knee as a wasting curse ravages him. His exposed greyish, drained, but still-human flesh withers and sinks against his bones, dark necrotic veins spreading from his throat, sickly olive-green and black miasma curling off his shrinking body. He clutches his chest, sword slipping from his grip. The background is a grim swamp at dusk, rotted black trees and low murky water.

The background is a grim rotted swamp at dusk, black dead trees and murky water.
